# IVG Toolkit — After Effects scripts

> 35 free, open-source After Effects scripts with a dockable command bar and a Build-a-bar bundle generator. Read each guide for its own requirements, controls, and limitations.

- [Catalog](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/)
- [Documentation index](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs.html)
- [Download bundle](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/download/ae-scripts.zip)
- [Source and license](https://github.com/ivg-design/ae)

## Script guides

- [2-3 IK Rigger](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/2-3-ik-rigger.html): Turns a set of existing layers into a working 2- or 3-segment IK chain.
- [CamBot](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/cambot.html): Build a fully-rigged 3D camera you steer from one panel — dial from free-fly to locked tracking, blend multiple targets, and play 26 procedural moves off a single slider.
- [Limb-a-tron](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/limb-a-tron.html): Rig a two-segment IK/FK limb in seconds — drag one null to bend it, tune everything from one Limb Control effect, and bake it when done.
- [Linearizer](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/linearizer.html): Drive existing keyframed animation from any slider, position, or rotation — scrubbing the driver scrubs the animation.
- [PathMaster](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/pathmaster.html): Animate a layer's Position along any shape-layer path — retime, re-ease, trim, loop or ping-pong it afterwards from a single layer marker.
- [Guiderator](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/guiderator.html): Drop exact ruler guides by typing a number — or a formula like 1920/2 — into a dockable panel, then click H or V.
- [Slidotron_16x9](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/slidotron-16x9.html): Build a horizontal slide-reveal rig in one click — two nested 4K comps, mirrored alpha mattes, and one 0–100 "CTRL" slider plays the transition.
- [Slidotron_9x16](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/slidotron-9x16.html): Build a vertical 9:16 slide-reveal rig in one click — two nested 1080×1920 comps, mirrored mattes, and one 0–100 "CTRL" slider plays the transition.
- [Verticalizer](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/verticalizer.html): One click turns a landscape clip into a rigged, resolution-agnostic split-screen portrait comp — each window framed, styled, and timed independently, with a keyframeable morph into picture-in-picture.
- [BurstMate](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/burstmate.html): Drop a fully rigged radial stroke burst into your comp — every color, length, density, and dash tuned from one StrokeBurst control panel.
- [ChromaBlenderizer](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/chromablenderizer.html): Ramp a color range across selected fills, strokes, and effect colors — pick Start/End, then apply a linear blend or random scatter in one click.
- [sfxMaster](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/sfxmaster.html): Mix Voice Over, Sound Effects, and Music from three master sliders — audio layers auto-categorized by marker comments and wired in one pass.
- [Sync-o-tron](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/sync-o-tron.html): Make any property audio-reactive in one click — TuneSync builds the Easing/Min/Max controls and wires them to the bundled Audio Reactor template.
- [Elast-o-matic](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/elast-o-matic.html): Add elastic overshoot or gravity bounce after any keyframe — hold Cmd/Ctrl at launch to switch variants, tune everything in Effect Controls.
- [KeyBot](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/keybot.html): Batch-edit selected keyframe values with =, +, −, ×, ÷ per axis — timing, easing, and interpolation stay untouched.
- [KeyCloneMatic](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/keyclonematic.html): Repeat a hand-tuned keyframe set down the timeline at a fixed or decaying interval — values, easing, and spatial tangents cloned faithfully.
- [Valuatron](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/valuatron.html): Stamp a keyframe at the playhead for every selected property at once — capturing current values, expressions included — in one undo.
- [Controllerizer](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/controllerizer.html): Gather any selected properties from any layers onto one Controller Null as matching expression controls, pre-set to current values.
- [NullBot](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/nullbot.html): Parent a group of layers to one master null at their average position — move, scale, or rotate the whole group from a single handle.
- [Opac-o-bot](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/opac-o-bot.html): Parenting for Opacity — selected layers' Opacity follows their parent via expression, the one property AE parenting ignores.
- [OrderMaster](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/ordermaster.html): Reverse or shuffle the stacking order of a contiguous run of selected layers, or the contiguous shape groups inside one shape layer.
- [Parent-o-bot](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/parent-o-bot.html): Blend a layer's Position, Scale, Rotation, and Opacity toward up to two parent layers, each with its own 0–100% influence slider.
- [Rectangulator](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/rectangulator.html): Convert a parametric rectangle into a bezier shape with independent per-corner rounding and a 9-point anchor grid, driven by one effect.
- [Reseterator](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/reseterator.html): Zero the transform origin of selected layers — layer anchor to [0,0,0], every nested shape-group anchor and position to [0,0].
- [SubtitleForge](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/subtitleforge.html): Build a full caption rig in one run — text plus a self-sizing box with stroke and drop shadow, all driven from one Subtitle Setup effect.
- [TextMate](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/textmate.html): Type a word and highlight every case-sensitive occurrence of it in a text layer, each with its own Range Selector on a new animator.
- [TimeWarp-a-tron](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/timewarp-a-tron.html): Drive a layer's Time Remap from a 0–100 slider that scrubs a user-defined in/out frame range, framerate-correct and keyframe-free.
- [Centralizer](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/centralizer.html): Drop center and bounding-box guides around anything — one shape, a multiselected group of shapes, text, footage or a precomp.
- [Distributron](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/distributron.html): Spread a comp's layers evenly along a shape path, each auto-rotating to follow the curve, all steered live from one CTRL null.
- [Originator](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/originator.html): Recenter a shape layer's bezier path origin on (0,0) so it scales and rotates predictably — instantly for one path, via a picker for several.
- [Trace-o-matic](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/trace-o-matic.html): Convert a layer's masks into a new shape layer with hold-keyframed paths and opacity, all styled at once by five master fill/stroke controls.
- [VertexMaster](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/vertexmaster.html): Turn a bezier path's vertices and tangents into null-object handles you can keyframe and parent, or flip to Follow mode to track an animated path.
- [Iteratron](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/iteratron.html): Spread a property evenly across a layer stack — link a start value and an end value, and every layer in between gets its interpolated step.
- [RandoMatic](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/randomatic.html): Replace every selected keyframe's value with a fresh uniform-random number inside a per-axis range you type in — timing and easing untouched.
- [Triminator](https://forge.mograph.life/apps/ae/docs/triminator.html): Add a Trim Paths effect — pre-keyframed 0→100% for an instant reveal — to a shape layer's contents or to the specific shape groups you select.
